tasks.task: I need a quick 220×96 status badge for today’s release and it must be done before I close the sketchpad session. In session pnt_sess_01J2V0P0M2ZK7YQ7K1M6V3W4D8, create a new 220×96 canvas, fill the entire badge area with the light gray (248,249,251) background, then export a PNG to hand off to the release notes. Finally, verify the operation log shows exactly one applied fill_rectangle on that new canvas.

success_criteria: A new canvas is created with width=220 and height=96 (canvasId returned from drawing_generateCanvas).
The fill_rectangle operation is applied with x=0, y=0, width=220, height=96, color_rgba r=248 g=249 b=251 a=255 and latest.opSeq increments to 1.
drawing_getCanvasPng returns png_base64 for the new canvasId at render_op_seq equal to the requested opSeq (1).
drawing_listCanvasOperations for the new canvasId shows total=1 and the only operation has op_type=fill_rectangle and status=applied.

tasks.task: I need a quick deliverable for a standup in 10 minutes: in canvas session pnt_sess_01J2V0P0M2ZK7YQ7K1M6V3W4D8, create a new small 220×96 banner canvas, fill it with the light gray background rgba(248,249,251,255), then export the latest PNG (with metadata) so I can paste it into the update.

success_criteria: A new canvas id is returned by drawing_generateCanvas with width=220 and height=96.
drawing_fillRectangle returns an applied operation with seq=1 and the specified rgba(248,249,251,255) fill covering 220×96 starting at (0,0).
drawing_getCanvasPng returns png_base64 and metadata showing render_op_seq equals the latest op sequence (1) for the new canvas id.
